meta.name: upgrade
meta.description: Upgrade the NotFair plugin to the latest version. Updates the marketplace repo, installs the new version to the plugin cache, and updates installed_plugins.json. Use when asked to "upgrade notfair", "update notfair", or "get latest version". Also handles inline upgrade prompts when a skill detects UPGRADE_AVAILABLE at startup.

copy.tagline: 一键升级 NotFair 插件到最新版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NotFair 插件并需要保持最新
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade NotFair plugin to the latest version with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NotFair plugin and need to keep it up to date

howto.what: 当用户要求升级NotFair插件时，Claude会从市场仓库拉取最新代码，安装到插件缓存，并更新已安装插件记录。如果技能启动时检测到可用更新，也会自动执行升级并显示更新日志。
howto.when: 当你说“升级NotFair”、“更新NotFair”或“获取最新版本”时触发；或者某个技能启动时输出UPGRADE_AVAILABLE也会自动触发。
howto.what_en: When asked to upgrade the NotFair plugin, Claude fetches the latest code from the marketplace repo, installs it into the plugin cache, and updates installed_plugins.json. It also auto-upgrades on startup if UPGRADE_AVAILABLE is detected, showing a changelog.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "upgrade notfair", "update notfair", or "get latest version"; also triggered automatically when a skill outputs UPGRADE_AVAILABLE at startup.
